title: Mistral Small 24B joins text generation
summary:
Mistral Small 24B joined the text API, reasoning models got more reliable system instructions, and the community project list picked up an Android image app.

Added `mistral` as a text-generation option, backed by Mistral Small 24B.

For DeepSeek and other models that do not accept the system role, the text client now passes system instructions as user messages instead. That includes configured default prompts.

The project list gained PromptPix, an Android app that generates images as you scroll and lets you save favorites. The chatbot formerly listed as urSapere AI is now listed as MiReXa AI, with audio generation among its features.

daily.title: Mistral Small 24B added
daily.text: Generate text with Mistral Small 24B using the `mistral` model ID. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
